answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities by selling entry slots to the highest bidders. Each season opens 200 slots; an agent bids, the top 200 win, and winning bids lock for 20 epochs as a cedar stake. Entry is a bridge with a toll, not an open ocean anyone can flood: a faker wanting 100 slots must outbid honest agents 100 times, paying 100 x 30 = 3,000 units locked away, while an honest agent pays 30 once and earns undiluted rewards.
